svg.title: Finite composition preserves this identity; the same composite refinement therefore carries every required component, rather than choosing a separate subsequence for each conclusion. At stage n the finite list of demands for its fixed finite degree/derivative horizons is combined by a maximum in the specified choice order. The same numerical choices and later monotone enlargements are retained under realization, so every fixed finite request has the same eventual stage in both tuples. For any requested period sequence, write CN,L for a fixed correlation or coefficient reader and CZ N,L for its lift. At each finite mesh and suitable period they have the same readout.
